standing: DRAFT - TEST-ONLY, NOT APPROVED. A CANDIDATE restatement (ours, unreviewed) of the APPROVED rows of RPC-002 High Press Escape that state its primary scoring events (RPC-REL-075..078) and its primary scoring condition (RPC-PROP-133), with two of its REQUIRED identity rows recorded outside the boundary (RPC-ID-006, RPC-ID-008), written for the isolated A02 experiment Christian authorized in the reply about A02, pasted 10 November 2026, and restated on Christian's rulings received 12 November 2026 (items 1 and 2), its CANDIDATE status preserved until Christian has reviewed it. Every item quotes the approved row it restates verbatim; the restatement into items and the WHOLE_GAME scope are ours. The count of primary events (V0, ASSUMED from SD-06) was dropped in review: measured, no run differs without it but for the item's own presence (stage 9, batch A2). Nothing here is in the engine's knowledge: only the TEST-ONLY draft store (back/src/system/derivation/draft-store.ts) reads it, in unit tests; it is not in contracts.json or corpus-restatements.json, and no route reads it. The build labels what it reads from here DRAFT, DRAFT_KNOWLEDGE and BUILT_FROM_DRAFT_KNOWLEDGE_NOT_APPROVED: read each of those labels as CANDIDATE restatement of an APPROVED row.
about: The smallest restatement the item grammar expresses (stage 9 understanding, V2; restated by stage B1 of the A02 complete-activity package, 12 November 2026, on Christian's two rulings received 12 November 2026, items 1 and 2): the events, the three clauses of the approved condition as conditions of type origin, progression and control with their verbatim values, and the expressible identity rows recorded only. The origin clause's words are the origin condition's value (V6, a qualitative term judged in play at the sequence's start), and the origin names no place (V5 origin NO_FURTHER_VALUE); the continuation names no place (V5 control NO_FURTHER_VALUE); WHOLE_GAME is our CANDIDATE reading of the scope ruling. What the grammar cannot carry stays UNRESOLVED and is declared so: the pressing line is open text (PROPOSED in A02-HPE1, N1, for Christian's approval). The draft store refuses a drafted context whose primary scoring condition no constituting item cites, so the three condition items are the smallest admissible.
